name: Heartful Days ~Hi no Ataru Basho e~
original_name: ハ～トフル・デイズ～陽のあたる場所へ～
source:
Spring. The season that gives you the preemptive feeling that something new has begun:
Living alone for the first time, or making new friends.

The differences between the yesterday and the today, where your new life begins, are vast.
Because what changed, were not only the things next to you.

- A Lovestory of university students who are taking their first step towards adulthood.

Because his parents had to travel for career purposes, our protagonist, who's in his second year at university, lives now alone for the first time of his life. The semester has just begun.

This new life now greets him with three heroines with whom he forms close bonds with.

- Fujikawa Yuki, childhood friend and the star player of the tennis club
- Kiyosumi Hiyori, a genius who was allowed skipping steps to be able to attend university.
- Misatomi Mai, an older beauty that can keep her cool.

Throughout the course of his college life, the protagonist develops deep friendships with these women in a fun and sometimes comical way.



[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20031211091003/http://www.mediaforce.jp/heroinemaker/game/hd.htm]the official site[/url]]
translation:
春天。让你产生新事物已经开始的预感的季节：第一次独自生活，或结交新朋友。昨天和今天的差异是巨大的，因为新的生活开始了。因为改变的，不仅仅是你身边的事物。——一部关于迈出成人第一步的大学生们的恋爱故事。因为父母工作需要出差，正在上大学二年级的主人公生平第一次独自生活。新学期刚刚开始。新生活中有三位女主角与他建立了亲密的羁绊。——藤川雪，青梅竹马兼网球部的明星选手。——清澄日和，被允许跳级上大学的天才少女。——乡真衣，能保持冷静的年长美女。在整个大学生活中，主人公以有趣且有时滑稽的方式与这些女孩们建立了深厚的友谊。

[来自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20031211091003/http://www.mediaforce.jp/heroinemaker/game/hd.htm]官方网站[/url]]
